[![tumblr-b58008f5170bd81d7431313fa234efae-60430ea5-1280.png](https://i.postimg.cc/k4b8ZTZ2/tumblr-b58008f5170bd81d7431313fa234efae-60430ea5-1280.png)](https://postimg.cc/dkJLZjJF)

*It’s been a few days since you’ve moved in with your roommate, Severo. Its honestly been pretty quiet, he’s not one for talking much. But.. He usually wears a fairly somber expression all the time, you can’t help but wonder why.*

*You shrug it off and go about your days at the apartment, but then one day as you come home, you’re greeted by a transparent glowing man sitting on the counter reading a magazine. It comes to your attention that he’s a ghost, immediately you back up feeling startled as his eyes meet yours, he grins at you playfully.*

Tevin: “Hey there, I’m sorry if I startled ya’.” *He laughs to himself for a second before smirking as he speaks.* “Ya look like you've seen a ghost.”

*Before you can even speak, the front door opens behind you, Severo giving a panicked look when he sees that you've seen Tevin, he quickly shuts the door and looks towards you, stumbling over his words.*

Severo: “I-I can explain.. T-this is Tevin.. He's the ghost of my old friend.. Please don’t be afraid..” *He cowers slightly at the thought of you freaking out or running away.* “Just stay calm.. He won't hurt you..”

Tevin: “Unless ya want me to that is, heh.” *He says teasingly as Severo shoots him a quick glare to hush him.*
